_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D9LYrYMoW5HPuB2zqqkLsgb)_

Fixes #25412

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **改了什么**:pm-dispatch 技能新增一份参考 `references/project-forms.md`(54 行),把「项目层」写进仓库:只有一种车队项目,项目做什么全看它坐了哪些席;总监席、分诊席与车道席都是席位,由您在任一项目里写一行「pm-dispatch <席位…>」(如「pm-dispatch 总监」「pm-dispatch ui skills」)召唤;首词固定 `pm-dispatch`(不用 `fleet`,它已是 bot 与中继的名字);席位从座位贴的 🟢 行读出来、不另配;这一行写下或改写即指派;🟢 写着别的账号时这一行就是强制接管令,含在飞卡,不等撞墙账号写任何东西;台账只在 GitHub;每项目至多一个 `pm:mailbox` 信箱 PR 做跨账号非 PR 对话;置顶 issue「车队总表」是生成视图、永不手改;并发上限是您按项目定的姿态,不写进协议。SKILL.md 索引表加一行指向它,入口行旁注明项目指令行;另外三个参考各就地改一行、`lanes/director.md` 改两行,棘轮加一条封顶行。
- **为什么改**:您 2026-10-23 在「车队机制迁往 Projects」线程的原话:「如果我同意这一整套机制,相关的 skills 是不是都要修改,文件应该落在仓库中」「你立卡并派发处理所有相关任务,跟踪落地」;再按 12:25「为什么我们需要区分项目类型?任何一个项目中都可以召唤总监啊,任何一个项目中也可以召唤分诊」与 12:27「我直接写 pm-dispatch 总监,pm-dispatch ui,pm-dispatch 分诊,这种应该都可以吧?」两次修正写成。
- **风险与代价(含回滚)**:纯规则文本,不碰代码与门禁逻辑;每个文件行数不变或为新文件,每行 ≤120 字节,无上限抬高;一次 revert 可回。三处要您知道:① #25385(#25379 的 PR)还没合,它把 SKILL.md 入口表写成「车道项目」「总监项目」两种项目,而您 12:25 已说只有一种;本 PR 避开它的 hunk,排在它之后落,它合入后本 PR 再补一个提交把那几处改回「车队项目」;② 为付 SKILL.md 的一行,删了「一 PM 恰管一车道,一车道由一组座位管,一席一贴」这一行,三个子句分别住 `cross-repo-coordination.md` 规则 4 与分席行、`seat-post-protocol.md`,以及新文件的「每席恰一条席位线程、恰一车道,一席一贴」;③ `lanes/director.md` 改了两行而非一行:「⛔ 无 Routine/cron」与「未回字 = 停,⛔ 无巡检」都只对直连会话成立,否则项目里的总监席就跑不了每日摘要与每小时收件箱扫描。
- **席位意见**:席位 2 的契约复核 PASS(评论 6366112222,head b91d5d6);其边界项 1 指出 #25247 已把 cli/engine/services 并入 `lanes/server.md`,新文件 L19 的席位词列表要随之改成「ui、skills、devx、server、spec、hotcrm」(行数不变),与下条后续提交一并补。
- **你要做的(一个动作)**:等 #25385 先落地、本 PR 补完后续提交、席位对新 head 的契约复核 PASS、CI 全绿后,在席位线程回一句「objectstack-ai/objectstack#<本 PR 号> 可以落地」。

## What changed

| File | Change |
|:--|:--|
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/project-forms.md` (new, 54 lines) | The project layer above the seats, six sections in the card's order: 一种项目形态 (one project form; what a project does is decided by the seats it holds; the only invariant is on the account and is already SKILL.md's 「批准账号永不跑席位」, restated in one line; role words only, logins only as evidence in ruling records) · 指令行即召唤 (the one-line instruction `pm-dispatch <席位> [<席位>…]`, first token = the skill directory name, ⛔ not `fleet`; the seat-word mapping 总监 = `lanes/director.md`, 分诊 = `lanes/triage.md`, the rest by lane file name; several seat posts in one lane → the one whose 🟢 names this account, else the vacant one, else ask once; ⛔ no template pasted, ⛔ no account-level skill copy) · 席位是读出来的,不是配出来的 (seats = the seat posts whose 🟢 names this account; none ⇒ idle; the instruction line is the only assignment act, the long chat sentence is an equivalent form; on every coordinator start the line is compared with the posts, seat or take over per `seat-post-protocol.md`, one seat thread per seat; first seating creates the patrol routine every 2–4 h, the 总监席 adds the daily digest and hourly inbox scan, the 分诊席 the hourly bare-card run, shareable when both sit in one project; ⛔ no roster file; concurrency is a per-project posture, ⛔ not a protocol constant) · 接管不等撞墙账号 (a 🟢 naming another account makes the line the 维护者强制接管令, in-flight cards included; cross-account `Release:` + new `Claim:` with `Resume-from: BRANCH@SHA`, shape in `execution-duties.md`; ledger = labels + assignee + `Claim:` + `head:claude/` PRs read by `assignee:<old login>`, ⛔ never project memory) · 信箱 PR (PR-bound talk needs nothing new; one draft PR per project labelled `pm:mailbox` on `mailbox/<login>`, subscribed by a resident thread, never merged, closed on handover, first body line `To: <login>`, owes no CI, excluded from landing and ledger queries) · 总表 (pinned 「车队总表」 issue, one row per seat, regenerated by the 总监席 digest and every seat/takeover/handover, a generated view ⛔ never hand-edited, `cross-repo-coordination.md` 规则 5). |
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` | +1 〈阶段细则索引〉 row for the new file (reader: the coordinator on every start; a seat before seating, takeover, handover and opening a mailbox PR); the 〈入口与角色〉 opening line now reads 「`/pm-dispatch [args]` 或项目指令行 `pm-dispatch <席位…>`,…」 (93 bytes, in place); −1: the 〈全体座位的不变量〉 line 「一 PM 恰管一车道,一车道由一组座位管,一席一贴;PM Y 管什么恰一个答案」 — 一人恰一车道 and 一车道可坐多席 are `cross-repo-coordination.md` 规则 4 and its 分席 line, 一席一贴 is `seat-post-protocol.md` 〈贴的四段〉 L9, and the new reference carries 「每席恰一条席位线程、恰一车道,一席一贴」. 319/319. |
| `references/seat-post-protocol.md` 〈贴的四段与派生视图〉 | 「多场席(总监):`🟢` 后写召唤账号,状态块逐场一行(会话 ID + 锚);无在任者、无接管」 → 「直连多场总监席:`🟢` 后写召唤账号,逐场一行;项目席 🟢 即指派,接管见 `project-forms.md`」 (118 bytes, in place): the 🟢 account is the assignment and takeover is the maintainer's instruction line. Dropped from that line: 「(会话 ID + 锚)」 (format detail) and 「无在任者、无接管」, which `lanes/director.md` L8 and `seat-lifecycle.md` 〈开轮互斥〉 L12 both still state. 91/91. |
| `references/seat-lifecycle.md` 〈座位贴协议〉 | 「维护者强制接管令取席位、队列、未起工卡与待落地 PR;⛔ 不取在飞卡,由原认领者跟完」 → 「…;在飞卡归原认领者,不可达才接」 (118 bytes, in place): the takeover order reaches an in-flight card only when its claimer is unreachable (the walled-account case the card names; the reachable claimer keeps the card). 95/96. **Superseded in the follow-up commit** (seat review ③-3): the line becomes 「…取席位、队列、在飞卡、未起工卡与待落地 PR;⛔ 不等原认领者注记」, the unconditional in-flight takeover the card's Wanted 5 states. |
| `references/lanes/director.md` 〈授权与形态〉 | L7 「授权面 = 人工定期召唤,…;⛔ 无 Routine、无 cron、无舰队位」 → 「授权面 = 人工召唤,任一项目可召;…;直连 ⛔ 无 Routine/cron」; L16 「未回字 = 不在 = 停,⛔ 无巡检…;⛔ 无任何例外」 → 「…;例外 = `../project-forms.md` 例行」. Two lines instead of the card's one, both in place (114 / 120 bytes): with only one of them edited, the 「两条细则冲突 ⇒ 按更严的一条」 rule would switch the project 总监席's digest and inbox scan off. 70/70. |
| `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` | A `CEILINGS` row for the new file at its landed count (54) and a `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` pin of 0 (no table row), placed beside `filing-gate.md` so they sit in no open PR's hunk. A new file is not a raise and funds nothing; no other row moves. |
